title: RowWriteResponse
description: Response body for both POST (append) and PUT (replace) /api/data-sources/:id/rows (HEL-1077). `rows` carries only the newly appended rows on POST, or the full new set on PUT. Row `data` is deliberately omitted -- readers fetch rows through the existing preview/read path. `deniedPipelines` (HEL-1096) lists every downstream pipeline this write denied auto-run for that the writer has visibility into -- empty when nothing was denied.
